Distinguish economic/node choices, mining proposals, developer proposals and service dependencies. Services must stay outside the editable protocol boundary.

conformance.reviewNote: Visually reviewed both PNG and JPG. Users, nodes, computing-based miners and developers surround distinct protocol and ledger books. Services sit apart to the right. The added hard-hat worker and laptop emblem were removed. No controlling participant or quantitative influence weights are invented. All required strings, qualifications, and relationships are preserved in the incorporated source brief and any attached guide text. Reference can be rebuilt as editable HTML/CSS/inline SVG.
